title: Big enough types
description:
Write these functions in `solution.c`, choosing types big enough for the answers:

```c
int seconds_in_days(int days);                  /* 1 day is 86,400 seconds */
long long seconds_in_years(int years);          /* a year is 365 days here */
unsigned char low_byte(int n);                  /* the lowest 8 bits of n: low_byte(300) is 44 */
int is_upper_letter(char c);                    /* 1 for 'A' to 'Z', otherwise 0 */
```

`seconds_in_years(100)` is 3,153,600,000, more than an `int` can hold (2,147,483,647), so the sum must be done in `long long`: convert **before** multiplying, `(long long)years * 365 * 86400`, not after.
